# Java Sync Driver - (current)

> Learn how to use the MongoDB Java Sync Driver.

- [Aggregation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/aggregation.md)
- [Aggregation Examples](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/aggregation/aggregation-examples.md)
- [Aggregation Expression Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/aggregation/aggregation-expression-operations.md): Learn to build aggregation pipeline expressions using typesafe Java methods in the MongoDB Java Driver, including arithmetic, array, string, and date operations.
- [API Documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/api-documentation.md): Read the API documentation for the MongoDB Java Driver and related packages.
- [MongoDB Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/atlas-search.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB Java Driver to run MongoDB Search queries, which let you perform full-text searches on your collections by using search indexes.
- [MongoDB Vector Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/atlas-vector-search.md): Learn about how to use MongoDB Vector Search in the MongoDB Java Driver.
- [Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders.md)
- [Aggregates Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/aggregates.md)

- [Indexes Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/indexes.md)
- [Projections Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/projections.md)
- [Sorts Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/sort.md)
- [Updates Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/updates.md)
- [Run a Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/command.md): Learn how to run database commands with the {+driver- long+} by using the runCommand() method to perform administrative and diagnostic tasks on a server.
- [Connection Guide](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/connection.md)
- [Connection Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/connection/connection-troubleshooting.md)

- [Cluster Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/connection/specify-connection-options/cluster-settings.md)
- [Configure Client-level CRUD Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/connection/specify-connection-options/configure-crud.md): Configure client-level CRUD settings in the MongoDB Java Driver, including read and write concerns, read preferences, and retryable reads and writes in Java.
- [Connection Pools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/connection/specify-connection-options/connection-pools.md)

- [CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud.md)
- [Bulk Write Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/bulk.md): Learn how to perform bulk operations by using the MongoDB Java Sync Driver
- [Collations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/collations.md)
- [Compound Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/compound-operations.md)
- [Configure Custom CRUD Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/crud-settings.md)
- [Delete Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/delete.md): Learn how to delete documents with the MongoDB Java Driver by using the deleteOne(), deleteMany(), and findOneAndDelete() methods with a query filter.
- [Large File Storage with GridFS](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/gridfs.md): Learn how to store and retrieve large files in MongoDB using GridFS with the Java Driver to split files into chunks for efficient storage.
- [Insert Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/insert.md): Learn how to insert documents with the MongoDB Java Driver by using the insertOne() and insertMany() methods, and how to handle the results of a write.
- [Query Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents.md): Learn about the commands for running read operations on MongoDB by using the MongoDB Java Driver.
- [Count Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/count.md): Learn about how to count the number of documents in a collection in the MongoDB Java Driver.
- [Access Data From a Cursor](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/cursor.md)
- [Retrieve Distinct Values of a Field](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/distinct.md): Learn about how to retrieve the number of distinct values of a field in the MongoDB Java Driver.
- [Find Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/find.md): Learn how to retrieve documents with the {+driver- long+} by using find operations, aggregation operations, and change streams to monitor live changes.
- [Search Geospatially](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/geo.md): Learn how to search geospatial data with the {+driver- long+}, including how to store GeoJSON data, create geospatial indexes, and run geospatial queries.
- [Limit the Number of Returned Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/limit.md)
- [Specify Which Fields to Return](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/project.md)
- [Skip Returned Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/skip.md)
- [Sort Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/sort.md)
- [Specify a Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/specify-query.md)
- [Query Text](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/query-documents/text.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB Java Driver to perform text queries to search for terms and phrases in specified fields within your MongoDB collections.
- [Configure Operations on Replica Sets](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/read-write-config.md)
- [Replace Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/replace-documents.md)

- [Tutorial: Run Multi-Document ACID Transactions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/transactions/multi-doc-acid-transactions.md): Learn how to run atomic multi-document transactions by using the Java driver.
- [Update Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/update-documents.md): Learn how to modify documents with the MongoDB Java Driver by using the updateOne(), updateMany(), and replaceOne() methods, and how to perform upserts.
- [Update Arrays in a Document](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/update-documents/embedded-arrays.md)
- [Insert or Update in a Single Operation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/crud/update-documents/upsert.md)

- [Encode Data with Type Codecs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/codecs.md)

- [Time Series Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/time-series.md)
- [Databases and Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/databases-collections.md)
- [Get Started with the Java Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/get-started.md): Learn how to create an app to connect to MongoDB deployment by using the Java driver.
- [MongoDB Java Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/index.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB Java Driver to connect to MongoDB, run CRUD operations, build aggregation pipelines, manage indexes, and work with BSON data.
- [Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/indexes.md)
- [Third-Party Integrations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations.md): Explore how to integrate the Java driver with frameworks like Spring Data, Quarkus, and Micronaut for developing applications.
- [Tutorial: Build a Quarkus Application with Panache and MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/panache.md): Learn how to build a Quarkus application with Panache and MongoDB to perform CRUD operations and aggregations.
- [Tutorial: Paginate Data with Java and Quarkus](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/quarkus-pagination.md): Learn how to implement offset and cursor-based pagination in a Quarkus application that connects to MongoDB.
- [Implement CSFLE in Java by Using Spring Data MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/spring-csfle.md)
- [Tutorial: Spring Data Framework Integration](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/spring-data-integration.md): Build an application using the Spring Data Framework and the MongoDB Java driver.
- [Tutorial: Build a Microservices App With MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/spring-microservice.md): Learn how to build a microservices architecture locally by using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and MongoDB in this step-by-step tutorial.
- [Tutorial: Query MongoDB with Spring Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/spring-queries.md): Learn how to create advanced queries using MongoRepository and MongoTemplate to interact with MongoDB in your Spring application.
- [Spring Session MongoDB Integration](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/spring-session.md): Learn how to use the Spring Session MongoDB module, which stores HTTP sessions in MongoDB, for reliable and scalable session storage in Java applications.
- [Get Started with Spring Session MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/spring-session/spring-session-get-started.md): Learn how to create a Spring application with Spring Boot that inserts data and uses MongoDB for storing user session information with Spring Session MongoDB.
- [Tutorial: Implement Sharding in Spring Boot by Using Spring Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/spring-sharding.md): Learn how to implement sharding in your Spring Boot application by using Spring Data MongoDB to scale your database horizontally.
- [Integration Testing with Java and MongoDB Using Testcontainers](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/integrations/testcontainers.md): Learn how to use Testcontainers with MongoDB for integration testing in Java and Spring Boot applications using Docker containers.
- [Issues & Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/issues-and-help.md): Find support for the Java Sync driver through online forums, report bugs or feature requests via Jira, and learn how to contribute to the driver.
- [Logging and Monitoring](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/logging-monitoring.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB Java Driver logging and monitoring tools.
- [Open Change Streams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/logging-monitoring/change-streams.md): Learn how to open a change stream with the {+driver- long+} to monitor real-time changes to a collection, database, or deployment in your application.
